key_phrases: full self-driving functionality being complete by the end of this year
manufacturing is the long-term sustainable advantage
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly optimistic, driven by Elon Musk's enthusiasm for FSD, new factories (Texas/Berlin), and the achievement of consecutive profitable quarters. Management shows high confidence ('we will', 'it's going to be stunning'), though the CFO provides a more grounded view on margin compression due to shutdowns. Forward guidance is strong regarding expansion and technology milestones. While there are clear supply chain risks and production bottlenecks mentioned (casting issues, nickel supply), they are framed as solvable engineering challenges rather than structural threats. Demand is explicitly stated to exceed supply. The only slight negativity comes from the reduction in automotive gross margins (20% to 18.7%) due to idle capacity charges.
